Nominal diameter DN200. Put /products/concrete-pump-elbow-dn200-90 in the subject. OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/concrete-pump-elbow-dn200-90. body.en: For Concrete Pump Elbow DN200 90, the heading “Weight” does not replace a cell. Nominal diameter DN200. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the DN200 90° Concrete Pump Elbow at /products/concrete-pump-elbow-dn200-90.

question.zh: 「质量」会替换「公称直径 DN200」吗？

answer.en: No. Bend 90° / R275 remains the printed wording for Concrete Pump Elbow DN200 90.
answer.zh: 不会。公称直径 DN200仍是DN200 90度混凝土泵弯管动力粒径 OEM 邢台询盘已印的说法。

answer.en: It belongs on /products/concrete-pump-elbow-dn200-90, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/concrete-pump-elbow-dn200-90，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Weight” add to Concrete Pump Elbow DN200 90?

answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/mass-weight-d_589.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。
